magnolia-tx.lead: Magnolia back porches often face open land and the full afternoon sun, and exterior patio shades let you sit out there without giving up the view.

faqs: Can I put a patio shade on my Las Colinas balcony?
It depends on your association's rules, so check those first. We can settle the fabric color and shade type at the free consultation and put them in a written quote.
Do exterior shades block streetlights at night in Las Colinas?
They are made for sun and glare. For bedrooms facing lights at night, an interior blackout shade or drapery does that job, and we plan it at the same visit.

argyle-tx.lead: Argyle studies at the front of the house face the street and the afternoon sun, and an exterior solar shade outside that window cuts glare without closing off the room.
argyle-tx.p1: A front-facing study in an Argyle home gets far more use than it used to, and its window often catches the late sun. An exterior solar shade mounted outside that glass cuts glare off the screen and stops heat before it enters. A tighter weave also blocks more of the view in from the street during the day.
argyle-tx.p2: The window behind you on calls is the one to start with. Inside, shutters or a roman shade can finish the study, and the exterior shade does the sun work. Both are measured on site at the same free consultation.
faqs: Can an exterior shade help my Argyle study on video calls?
Mounted outside the window behind the desk, it cuts glare and heat before they reach the room, which evens out the bright window behind you.
Do exterior shades give street privacy in Argyle?
A tighter weave blocks more of the view in during the day while still letting light through. We often pair it with shutters or a shade inside.

justin-tx.lead: Justin open floor plans put the kitchen, dining and living windows in one view, and the patio shade outside them is part of that same picture.
justin-tx.p1: From the kitchen in a Justin open plan, you see straight out to the patio, so the shade there reads as part of the main floor. We pick its fabric color from the same color family as the interior treatments. The weave is set by direction, tighter if the patio takes the afternoon sun.
justin-tx.p2: The kitchen window beside the patio often catches the same sun. With the patio shade down, that glass is shaded too, which takes some of the load off the treatment over the sink. Each opening is measured on site and built to its own numbers.
faqs: Can my Justin patio shade match the interior color plan?
Yes, outdoor roller shades come in a range of fabric colors, and we choose one in the same family as the treatments on your main floor.
Do patio shades in Justin shade the windows behind the patio?
When lowered at the patio edge, they stop the sun before it reaches the glass behind, and the rooms there take less heat.

boyd-tx.lead: Out in the country around Boyd, wind reaches the house from every side, so exterior shades there are planned around track-guided hardware and retractable fabric.
boyd-tx.p1: Weather crosses open ground before it reaches a Boyd home, and an exterior shade has to be set up for that. Track guides keep the fabric in place when gusts hit, and retractable shades roll up out of wind and hail. We size the hardware to each opening and go through the wind guidance at the consultation.
boyd-tx.p2: In July, a shade on the west patio keeps the afternoon heat off the glass behind it. In January, a retractable shade stays rolled up, and the interior cellular shades and shutters handle the cold. A motor makes raising shades before a storm quick.
faqs: Are patio shades practical in windy Boyd?
Yes, with the right hardware. Track-guided systems keep the fabric in place, retractable shades roll up out of the weather, and shades should be raised in high wind.
Do Boyd patio shades need to come down in winter?
Retractable shades can stay rolled up through the colder months, which keeps the fabric out of wind and hail. Inside, cellular shades and shutters handle the cold.

westlake-tx.lead: In a large Westlake home, raising patio shades by hand is a chore nobody keeps up with, and motorized exterior shades on a schedule take it off the list.
westlake-tx.p1: A Westlake patio can span several wide openings, and a large exterior shade is heavy to crank by hand every day. Motorized patio shades run from a remote, a wall switch, an app or a schedule, and the sunny side comes down in the afternoon without anyone thinking about it. Hardwired, battery and solar charged motors are options.
westlake-tx.p2: Interior shades in a Westlake home are often grouped by room and side of the house, and the patio deserves the same planning. We set out which openings take afternoon sun and size the hardware on each shade to its span.
faqs: Can Westlake patio shades run on a schedule?
Yes, motorized patio shades can run on a schedule or an app, lowering for the afternoon sun and raising when it passes.
What powers motorized patio shades in Westlake?
Battery, hardwired or solar charged motors. We recommend one based on the patio and how the house is wired.

paradise-tx.lead: A Paradise patio that wraps a corner takes morning sun on one side and afternoon sun on the other, so each side gets its own shade and weave.
paradise-tx.p1: On a corner patio in Paradise, the morning wall and the afternoon wall need different things. A more open weave suits the morning side, where the sun is milder, and a tighter weave suits the afternoon side. Each opening is measured on site and built separately, and the two shades still meet cleanly at the corner post.
paradise-tx.p2: Corner bedrooms take the same two-sided sun, and exterior solar shades on those windows stop heat before it reaches the glass. Motorized versions can run each wall on its own schedule, with the east windows lowering early and the west ones later in the day.
faqs: Can a corner patio in Paradise use two different shade weaves?
Yes, each side is measured and built on its own, so the morning side can take a more open weave and the afternoon side a tighter one.
Do you install exterior shades on corner bedroom windows in Paradise?
Yes, exterior solar shades mount outside the glass and stop heat before it enters, and motorized ones can run each wall on its own schedule.
